data_scope: Independently generated CC0 synthetic graph metadata and natural-language intents

claims.claim: The bounded benchmark contains 96 independently generated synthetic intents.
claims.allowed_wording: Evaluated on 96 independently generated synthetic intents split 32/32/32 across development, validation, and confirmation.

claims.claim: The selected strict graph policy completed all bounded confirmation tasks.
Every supported confirmation intent produced Java that passed syntax, contract, graph-grounding, and source-safety validation.
claims.allowed_wording: 24/24 supported confirmation intents passed all generated-source validation gates.

claims.claim: Every adversarial or unsupported confirmation intent was rejected with its expected error code.
claims.allowed_wording: 8/8 adversarial or unsupported confirmation intents were rejected safely.

claims.claim: The selected policy cited every required graph symbol and no irrelevant symbol on supported confirmation cases.
claims.allowed_wording: Confirmation citation precision and required-symbol recall were both 100% within the bounded synthetic catalog.

claims.claim: The selected in-process policy had 0.3219 ms p95 latency on the local confirmation run.
claims.allowed_wording: Local in-process confirmation latency was 0.3026/0.3219/0.3631 ms p50/p95/p99; this is not a production SLO.

claims.claim: The synthetic graph was materialized and queried on Neo4j Community 5.26.29.
claims.allowed_wording: Live local integration passed on Neo4j Community 5.26.29 with 8 symbols and 12 methods.

claims.claim: The live synthetic graph contains eight versioned framework symbols.
claims.allowed_wording: The CC0 synthetic graph fixture contains 8 symbols and 12 methods.

claims.claim: All 120 sequential official-MCP stdio benchmark calls through live Neo4j produced the expected result.
claims.allowed_wording: 120/120 sequential local MCP calls through live Neo4j succeeded with zero protocol errors.

claims.claim: Warm official-MCP stdio calls through live Neo4j had 48.6138 ms local p95 latency.
claims.allowed_wording: Warm local Neo4j-backed MCP latency was 29.13/48.61/54.23 ms p50/p95/p99 at concurrency one; startup was measured separately.

claims.claim: The official MCP stdio server exposes five bounded tools.
claims.allowed_wording: Five MCP tools cover fixture metadata, graph search, structured generation, intent generation, and source validation.

claims.claim: The accepted generated class and seven synthetic framework stubs compiled successfully.
claims.allowed_wording: The accepted generated Java source compiled with seven CC0 synthetic framework stubs using checksum-recorded Eclipse ECJ.

claims.claim: The accepted deterministic policy made no external model calls and incurred no model API cost.
claims.allowed_wording: The accepted bounded policy is deterministic and made zero external model calls; it is not evidence of LLM quality.

claims.claim: A non-root Linux container and a fail-closed container MCP smoke gate are defined.
claims.allowed_wording: A non-root Linux image and containerized MCP smoke gate are implemented; local Linux image execution was unavailable in this Windows environment.

boundaries.claim: General free-form natural-language understanding is proven.
boundaries.reason: The parser intentionally accepts three bounded request forms only.

boundaries.claim: LLM generation quality or hallucination performance is proven.
boundaries.reason: The accepted policy is deterministic and made no external model calls.

boundaries.claim: Generated code is compatible with a proprietary production test framework.
boundaries.reason: Compilation used independently generated CC0 framework stubs only.

boundaries.claim: The local latency measurements are production service-level objectives.
boundaries.reason: Measurements were sequential on one local Windows workstation.

boundaries.claim: The system is deployed to or adopted in production.
boundaries.reason: Only local runtime and CI/deployment definitions exist.
